title: 256 photo faces for generic people
items: The generic-adult photo preview now has 256 fictional faces with varied ages, skin tones and features. A paged source/before/after gallery shows sixteen fitted heads at a time.

A small crowd sheet and one nearby detail page keep added face textures within a fixed budget as the library grows. Source-guided eyes retain iris detail; historical likenesses and visitor choices keep priority. Single-photo imports use the same review.
